This '''unidentified operative''' was hired by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after the ecological disaster on Clak'dor VII. The operative provided food supplies and medicine for the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], which resulted in their loyalty to the Rebels being secured.
